_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior garage door prime+paint (new construction). Context prefix GRDR (GaRage DooR) — no collision with existing prefixes (CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, XDOR, XTRM). Combined prime+finish in single spec (same mobilization). Single paintable item (garage door assembly EA) with 3 substrate types, 4 panel complexities, 2 door sizes as modifiers. QT3-QT4 only (QT2 excluded — visible from street; QT5 excluded — utility surface, not architectural showcase).

paintable_items.name: Exterior garage door assembly
paintable_items.notes: Single EA item covering the complete garage door exterior face: all panels, recesses, window inserts (if present), panel edges at articulation joints. Does NOT include: garage door casing/trim (SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1 scope), interior/garage-side face, weatherstripping, spring hardware, tracks. Door size (single vs double) is a modifier within EA. Panel complexity (flush/raised/carriage/windows) is a modifier. Substrate (steel/wood/carriage) drives primer system.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, XDOR, XTRM. GRDR is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_GRDR_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_GRDR_WAX_REMOVE, TSK_GRDR_DEGLOSS, TSK_GRDR_ADHESION_TEST, TSK_GRDR_PRIME_DTM_SPRAY, TSK_GRDR_PRIME_ACRYLIC_SPRAY, TSK_GRDR_FINISH_SPRAY_1, TSK_GRDR_SAND_INTERCOAT, TSK_GRDR_MASK_WINDOWS, TSK_GRDR_SEAL_BOTTOM, TSK_GRDR_LEAPFROG_ARTICULATE

expected_modules.notes: Protection setup — driveway/apron protection (canvas drops, NOT poly sheeting — safety hazard), adjacent siding masking (spray method), weatherstrip masking, track/hardware masking, bottom seal removal or prop management, window masking (if integrated windows present).

Surface prep — substrate-driven: Steel: wax removal (3M gray synthetic steel wool + biodegradable cleaner) → degloss (120-150 grit or chemical) → ASTM D3359 adhesion test. Wood: sand → fill → tannin spot-prime (cedar/redwood). Carriage: mixed-material prep per overlay type.

Primer application — substrate-driven: Steel: DTM acrylic primer (mandatory even over factory primer due to wax contamination). Wood: 100% acrylic exterior primer (alkyd stain-blocker for tannin species). Carriage: DTM on steel base + bonding primer on composite overlays (conditional). Six-side sealing for wood doors per DASMA TDS #162.

First finish coat — spray primary method. Leapfrog technique mandatory for sectional doors: paint alternating panels (1,3,5 then 2,4,6), opening each joint to dry tack-free before painting adjacent. Brush for panel recesses (raised panel, carriage overlays). 100% acrylic exterior latex for all substrates.

Intercoat inspection and maintenance. QT3: visual inspect for runs/sags/holidays, touch up defects. QT4: light sand 220-grit between finish coats, raking light inspection. Re-verify leapfrog joint separation.
Second finish coat — same leapfrog method as coat 1. Same material system. Spray + brush detail for recesses.

Final inspection — verify complete coverage, no bridged joints, clean masking lines at windows and hardware zones. Balance test checkpoint (SOP quality gate — not billable). Verify bottom seal clearance.

Protection teardown — remove driveway drops, remove siding masking, remove window masking, remove weatherstrip tape, reinstall bottom seal (if removed), lower door to threshold, verify articulation (door opens/closes freely). Tool cleaning.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of garage doors in scope. Each door assembly is 1 EA regardless of size (single or double). Door size is captured separately as a modifier.
paintscope_keys.notes: Primary quantity driver. From research.json required_paintscope_keys.

paintscope_keys.description: Garage door substrate material — steel, wood, or carriage (mixed). Per-door capture for mixed-type projects. Drives primer system, prep protocol, and failure mode profile.
paintscope_keys.notes: Values: steel, wood, carriage. From research.json proposed_new_keys.

paintscope_keys.description: Garage door size — single (8x7/9x7 ft, 56-63 SF) or double (16x7/18x7 ft, 112-126 SF). Primary rate modifier within EA counting.
paintscope_keys.notes: Values: single, double. From research.json proposed_new_keys.

paintscope_keys.description: Panel complexity — flush, raised_panel, carriage, or windows. Production rate modifier. Flush = 1.00x, raised_panel = 1.10x, carriage = 1.25-1.40x. Windows is additive (+0.5-1.5 hrs).
paintscope_keys.notes: Values: flush, raised_panel, carriage, windows. Panel_type and windows are independent — windows can coexist with any panel type. From research.json proposed_new_keys.

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag confirming new construction context.
paintscope_keys.notes: Already registered by sibling exterior specs (wood siding, fiber cement, exterior trim, exterior door).

paintscope_keys.description: SF of driveway/apron surface within overspray/drip zone requiring protection during garage door painting.
paintscope_keys.notes: Required when application_method is spray. Canvas drops or absorbent mats — NOT standard poly sheeting (safety hazard on hardscapes). From research.json required_paintscope_keys.

quality_tier.notes: QT2 excluded — garage doors are visible from street, not economy-appropriate. QT5 excluded — utility surface, not architectural showcase like entry doors. Narrow 2-tier range reflects the functional character of garage doors.

application_method.notes: Spray is PRIMARY for garage door faces (large flat panels, ideal for airless spray). Brush is for panel recesses on raised-panel doors and detail work on carriage-style doors. Roller is NOT valid for metal doors (introduces orange peel). Back-rolling AVOIDED on metal doors per Application Methods Doctrine.

sheen.notes: No locked-in default — project-level selection per Exterior_Color_Sheen_Configuration_Doctrine. Semi-gloss is most common for garage doors. Gloss requires higher prep quality. All are valid for this spec.

phase.notes: Combined prime+finish spec. No 'apply' phase — uses 'prime' and 'finish' directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: EA is primary UOM for the garage door assembly. FIXED for per-project fixed tasks (tool cleaning). No SF or LF direct — everything is bundled into the per-EA rate. Rates are hours/EA, not SF/hr.

substrate_state.notes: SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY is dominant NC state for steel doors (~85%). SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD for wood panel doors. SS_EXT_BARE_METAL is rare in NC (factory primer damaged). Factory-primed steel STILL needs DTM primer after wax removal (unlike entry doors). SS_EXT_BARE_METAL and SS_EXT_PAINTED_GLOSS are proposed by SF_DOOR_EXT_NC_v1 — reused here.

product_role.notes: No sealer/clear/stain/specialty needed for garage doors. DTM primer and acrylic primer cover all substrate paths. Topcoat is 100% acrylic latex for all substrates.

protection_level.notes: Full_cover for driveway/apron. Full_mask for adjacent siding and window glass. Item_mask for weatherstrip, track hardware, bottom seal.

edge_type.notes: All garage door adjacencies are linear (door edge to casing, door bottom to driveway). No complex multi-plane junctions.

typical_relationship.notes: Garage door is always a different finish from surrounding casing, siding, and driveway. No same_finish adjacencies.

modifier_mechanism.notes: QT3 = baseline (1.00). QT4 = selective_multiplier (1.15 on qt_scaled tasks). No additional_rounds — both tiers get 2 finish coats. No excluded tier within the 2-tier range.

surface_ids.notes: garage_door_ext is proposed (new surface ID for exterior garage door face). ext_trim_garage_casing is proposed (garage door casing/trim — distinct from entry door casing). siding_field is existing. driveway_hardscape is proposed (non-painted protection target). garage_interior_ceiling is proposed (non-painted protection target for overspray when door is open). All adjacent surfaces are protection targets — no cut-in lines. Casing belongs to trim spec.

zone_ids.notes: Driveway/apron below garage door. Full cover mandatory for spray. Canvas drops or absorbent mats — NOT standard poly (safety hazard). From research.json protection_zones_analysis.
Siding panels adjacent to garage door opening. Full mask for spray. No separate PS key — included in per-door setup estimate.
Window inserts in garage door panels. HDPE static-cling film. Conditional — only when windows present. Time driven by window count as additive modifier.
Weatherstripping contact surfaces along sides and top of door. Item mask to prevent paint contamination. Paint destroys seal flexibility.
Track and roller contact points, spring mechanism hardware, cables, brackets. Must NOT be painted — causes binding. Mask before spray.
Bottom weatherseal (astragal). Either remove before painting or mask. Prop door 2-4 inches during 24-48 hour cure. Dedicated management task.

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_PRIMER_STEEL_DTM — interior DTM primer for steel windows, similar chemistry but interior context
SYS_PRIMER_BONDING — bonding primer for smooth/hard substrates (cabinets), may apply to carriage composite overlays
SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_ACRYLIC — exterior acrylic primer for wood siding, same chemistry concept
SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_TANNIN — exterior tannin-blocking primer for cedar/redwood siding
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_STANDARD — standard exterior acrylic finish (QT3 siding)
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_PREMIUM — premium exterior acrylic finish (QT4 siding)
SYS_EXT_DOOR_PRIMER_DTM — proposed by SF_DOOR_EXT_NC_v1 for steel entry doors, similar DTM concept
SYS_EXT_DOOR_FINISH_STANDARD — proposed by SF_DOOR_EXT_NC_v1 for QT3 entry doors

proposed_systems.name: DTM Primer for Steel Garage Doors
proposed_systems.notes: Acrylic DTM primer with rust-inhibitive pigments (~46% volume solids). Mandatory for ALL steel garage doors after wax removal and deglossing — factory primer alone is NOT adequate due to wax contamination. Flash-rust resistant, flexible for thermal expansion. Coverage: 350-400 SF/gal.

proposed_systems.name: 100% Acrylic Exterior Primer for Wood Garage Doors
proposed_systems.notes: Standard 100% acrylic latex exterior primer. For non-tannin species (pine, fir, spruce). For tannin-rich species (cedar, redwood), supplement with alkyd stain-blocker. Coverage: 400-450 SF/gal.

proposed_systems.name: Alkyd Stain-Blocking Primer for Tannin-Rich Wood Garage Doors
proposed_systems.notes: Required for cedar, redwood, fir garage doors. Deep penetration, superior tannin blocking. May be spot-applied at knots under full acrylic primer, or full-surface for severe tannin species. Coverage: 350-400 SF/gal.

proposed_systems.name: Bonding Primer for Carriage-Style Composite Overlays
proposed_systems.notes: Conditional — only needed when carriage overlays have glossy/sealed composite surfaces. Grips slick composite while providing tooth for topcoat. Products: Stix, Extreme Bond. Coverage: 350-400 SF/gal.

proposed_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Latex for Garage Doors
proposed_systems.notes: Mid-grade 100% acrylic exterior latex. SW SuperPaint, BM Regal Select, or equivalent. 2 coats. Works on all three substrates (steel, wood, carriage). Satin/semi-gloss/gloss per project selection. Coverage: 300-400 SF/gal.

proposed_systems.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic Latex for Garage Doors
proposed_systems.notes: Premium 100% acrylic (SW Emerald, BM Aura). Superior UV resistance, self-cleaning technology, enhanced color retention. 2 coats with interstage sand. Coverage: 300-400 SF/gal.

material_system_prefix.notes: 4 substrate-driven primers (DTM for steel, acrylic for wood, alkyd stain-blocker for tannin wood, bonding for carriage composites) + 2 QT-driven finish systems. All topcoats are 100% acrylic exterior latex — same chemistry across all substrates. LRV restriction: carriage/composite doors LRV > 55 (HARD STOP). Steel doors LRV > 30 (IR-reflective recommended below 30).

proposed_consumables.name: 3M Gray Synthetic Steel Wool Pad (#000 equivalent)
proposed_consumables.notes: For factory wax removal on steel garage doors. Saturated with biodegradable cleaner. Spec-unique consumable — no other spec requires synthetic steel wool.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 310 (metal garage doors)
proposed_consumables.notes: 310 or 412 tip for metal garage door faces. 0.010-0.014 inch orifice per Application Methods Doctrine. 100-mesh blue filter for enamel on steel.

proposed_consumables.name: Canvas Driveway Runner / Absorbent Mat
proposed_consumables.notes: Driveway protection for spray operations. Canvas drops or absorbent mats — NOT standard poly sheeting (slippery safety hazard on hardscapes). Per door setup.

proposed_configurations.description: 1 DTM/acrylic prime + 2 finish coats — standard NC for all garage door substrates
proposed_configurations.notes: All garage doors get prime + 2 finish. Factory-primed steel STILL gets DTM primer (factory primer is inadequate due to wax). No skip-prime path for garage doors.

round_configurations.notes: Single round configuration — all garage doors get prime + 2 finish coats regardless of substrate state. Unlike entry doors where factory-primed can skip field prime, garage doors always need DTM primer over factory finish due to wax contamination. This simplifies to one round config.

proposed_profiles.description: DTM primer coverage on steel garage door — 350-400 SF/gal. Single door ~56-63 SF = ~0.14-0.18 gal/door. Double door ~112-126 SF = ~0.28-0.36 gal/door.
Acrylic primer coverage on wood garage door — 400-450 SF/gal. Single door = ~0.12-0.16 gal/door. Double door = ~0.25-0.32 gal/door.

Finish coat coverage on primed garage door — 300-400 SF/gal per coat. 2 coats. Single door = ~0.14-0.21 gal/door/coat. Double door = ~0.28-0.42 gal/door/coat. Spray at 50-70% transfer efficiency — budget 25-33% more material.

deduplication_notes: Garage door CASING/TRIM painting belongs to SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1 — this spec covers the door panel assembly only.
Driveway/apron protection IS this spec's responsibility — not the siding spec or trim spec.
Adjacent siding masking during garage door spray IS this spec's responsibility (overspray source is the garage door).
Garage door trim/casing protection DURING SIDING SPRAY is NOT this spec's responsibility — belongs to siding spec.
Entry door painting (SF_DOOR_EXT_NC_v1) is completely separate. No shared EA count, no shared PS keys. Different context prefix (XDOR vs GRDR).

proposed_modifiers.description: Door size modifier — primary EA-to-time scaling factor
proposed_modifiers.notes: Single door (56-63 SF) = 1.00x baseline. Double door (112-126 SF) = 1.85x (not exactly 2x because setup/cleanup is fixed per door). Field calibration recommended.

proposed_modifiers.description: Panel complexity modifier — production rate multiplier
proposed_modifiers.notes: Flush = baseline (continuous spray/roller). Raised_panel = +10% (brush work in recesses). Carriage = +30% (meticulous masking, multi-tone cutting, overlay detail). Carriage range is 1.25-1.40x per doctrine — using 1.30x as default.

proposed_modifiers.description: Window masking additive time — independent of panel complexity
proposed_modifiers.notes: Additive time in hours per door. Standard = small window inserts in top panel. Divided-lite = carriage-style divided-lite patterns requiring individual pane masking. Range is 0.5-1.5 hrs per doctrine.
Steel = baseline (wax removal + degloss included in base rate). Wood = +15% (six-side seal + grain management per DASMA TDS #162). Carriage = +25% (mixed materials + overlay detail).

production_json.ea_rate_note: This spec uses hours/EA rates (not SF/hr or LF/hr). Production rates should use rate_per_hour where the rate is doors/hour (inverse of hours/door) or fixed_time_minutes for per-door tasks.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup → prep → prime → apply → interstage → finish → cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_GRDR_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: ITM_GARAGE_DOOR MUST be used exactly as registered (proposed ID)
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Garage Door Prime and Paint (New Construction)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for exterior garage doors — distinct from exterior entry doors (SF_DOOR_EXT_NC). Different substrate handling (wax removal on steel, DASMA TDS #162 six-side sealing on wood), different application technique (leapfrog for sectional articulation), different protection zones (driveway, track hardware), different QT range (QT3-QT4 vs QT3-QT5 for entry doors).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior garage door assembly
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing ITM_ covers garage doors. Interior door items (ITM_DOOR_FRAME_SET) cover frames. Exterior entry door item (ITM_DOOR_EXT proposed) covers entry doors. Garage doors are physically distinct: sectional panel assemblies with articulation joints, track systems, and weatherseals.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior garage door face surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New surface ID for garage door exterior face. No existing surface_id covers this. Distinct from door_slab_ext (entry door slab) and siding_field. Garage doors have unique characteristics: sectional panels with articulation joints, integrated windows, track/hardware exclusion zones.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Garage door casing/trim surround
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New surface ID for garage door casing. Distinct from ext_trim_door_casing (entry door casing). Garage door casing is typically wider and may have different profile than entry door casing.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Driveway/apron hardscape (protection target, not painted)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Non-painted surface that requires protection during garage door spray operations. Needed for adjacency declaration and protection zone mapping.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Garage door driveway/apron protection zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New protection zone for driveway below garage door. Distinct from ext_hardscape_walk and ext_hardscape_patio (generic exterior zones). Garage-specific because driveway is directly below spray zone and has unique protection requirements (canvas — NOT poly).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Siding adjacent to garage door opening (spray masking)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New protection zone for siding panels flanking the garage door opening. Pre-taped poly or masking film during garage door spray. No separate PS key — included in per-door setup.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Garage door window insert masking
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New protection zone for window inserts in garage door panels. HDPE static-cling film. Conditional on windows present. Distinct from ext_door_glass_mask (entry door glass).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Garage door weatherstrip masking
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New protection zone for weatherstripping contact surfaces on garage doors. Paint destroys seal flexibility. Distinct from ext_door_weatherstrip (entry door weatherstrip).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Garage door track and spring mechanism masking
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New protection zone unique to garage doors. Tracks, rollers, springs, cables, brackets — must NOT be painted (causes binding). No analogous zone in any other spec.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Garage door bottom seal (astragal) management zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New protection zone for bottom weatherseal. Either remove before painting or mask + prop door during cure. Unique to garage doors — no analogous zone in other specs.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Garage Door Count (EA)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PaintScope key for garage door count. No existing PS key covers garage doors. Entry doors use PS_EXT_OPENING_EA.DOOR_EXT (proposed). Garage doors need a separate key because they are scoped and counted independently from entry doors.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Garage Door Substrate Material Enum (steel/wood/carriage)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New per-door enum for substrate material. Drives primer system, prep protocol, and failure mode profile. Must be per-door — project can have mixed types.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Garage Door Size Enum (single/double)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New per-door enum for size. Primary rate modifier — double door is 1.85x single. Must be per-door for mixed-size projects.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Garage Door Panel Complexity Enum (flush/raised_panel/carriage/windows)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New per-door enum for panel complexity. Secondary production rate modifier. Must be per-door for mixed-type projects.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Driveway Protection Area (SF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PaintScope key for driveway/apron protection area. No existing PS_EXT_PROTECT covers driveway specifically. Needed for spray method protection material quantity.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Garage Door Count Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_OPENING_EA.DOOR_GARAGE.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Garage Door Substrate Enum Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.GARAGE_DOOR_SUBSTRATE.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Garage Door Size Enum Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.GARAGE_DOOR_SIZE.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Garage Door Panel Type Enum Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.GARAGE_DOOR_PANEL_TYPE.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Driveway Protection Area Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_PROTECT_SF.DRIVEWAY.

registry_additions_proposed.name: DTM Primer for Steel Garage Doors
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Distinct from entry door DTM primer (SYS_EXT_DOOR_PRIMER_DTM) and interior steel DTM (SYS_PRIMER_STEEL_DTM). Garage door DTM primer addresses factory wax contamination — a unique requirement not shared by entry doors or windows.

registry_additions_proposed.name: 100% Acrylic Exterior Primer for Wood Garage Doors
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Garage-door-specific acrylic primer. Same chemistry as siding primer (SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_ACRYLIC) but different coverage rates on EA door vs SF siding. Includes six-side sealing obligation per DASMA TDS #162.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Alkyd Stain-Blocking Primer for Tannin-Rich Wood Garage Doors
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Required for cedar, redwood, fir garage doors. Same concept as SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_TANNIN but garage-door-specific context with EA-based coverage.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Bonding Primer for Carriage-Style Composite Overlays
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Conditional primer for glossy/sealed composite overlay panels on carriage-style doors. Similar concept to SYS_PRIMER_BONDING (cabinets) but exterior context with UV/weather exposure.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Latex for Garage Doors
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT3 garage door finish. Same product class as siding finish but different coverage rates on EA door and different application technique (leapfrog spray).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic Latex for Garage Doors
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT4 garage door finish with premium materials (SW Emerald, BM Aura). Higher durability, UV resistance, color retention.

registry_additions_proposed.name: DTM Primer Coverage on Steel Garage Door
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Garage-door-specific DTM primer coverage. EA-based conversion needed.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Primer Coverage on Wood Garage Door
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Garage-door-specific acrylic primer coverage.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Finish Coat Coverage on Primed Garage Door
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Garage-door-specific finish coverage. Accounts for spray transfer efficiency.
